title: Yosuga no Sora: In Solitude Where We are Least Alone
synopsis:
Haruka Kasugano and his twin sister Sora have lost both their parents in an accident, and with them all their support. They decide to move out of the city to the rural town where they once spent summers with their late grandfather. At first everything seems familiar and peaceful, but changes come as Haruka starts to remember things from his youth.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Distant Memories
episodes.synopsis: After the sudden death of their parents, Haruka and his twin sister Sora move to their grandparents' house, hoping to create a new life with old, and new, friends.

episodes.title: Akira Embarrassed
episodes.synopsis: Sora finally starts attending school with Haruka, though she is disappointed to find that she and Haruka are in different classes. Does Haruka misinterpret a conversation he was not meant to hear?

episodes.title: Indecision
episodes.synopsis: Even as Kazuha is guilt-ridden and upset over Akira's standing, Haruka determines that a date with Kazuha might make the whole situation better.

episodes.title: Haruka's Heart
episodes.synopsis: Kazuha and Akira have a deep connection, one that only they acknowledge. Haruka is instrumental in providing some clarity to Kazuha's misconceptions.

episodes.title: Darkness Revealed

episodes.title: I Won't Give Up

episodes.synopsis: Sora becomes even more insecure when she learns the details of a drowning accident that almost took the life of her brother.
